integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic fashion film, one continuous take. The Atelier Sans Titre summer show opens at a runway on a beach of pale sand beside the surf: the guests settle along both sides of the runway with their phones raised as the lights come up. The camera tracks the moving subject at slow speed. The low sun glares off every lens in the front row. The shot ends as the runway lies empty under the lights, waiting.

overall_soundscape: A murmuring crowd and the first notes of a brass band.

non_diegetic_music: A swaggering brass cakewalk over a slow, heavy techno kick.

The camera tracks the moving subject at slow speed. A model with waist-long braids gathered into a crown struts down the runway toward the camera in a sheer organza dress over a boxy grey tailored jacket, high-stepping in time with the brass like an old cakewalk. The open air tugs at the hem as she passes. The shot ends as the model reaches the end of the runway, poses and turns back.

overall_soundscape: Heel strikes in time with the brass and a ripple of camera shutters.
